title: News Words: Triumph
source: VOA Learning English (미국 정부 제작물 - 퍼블릭 도메인). 원문: https://learningenglish.voanews.com/a/7955943.html

sentences.text: Welcome to the Voice of America's Newswords.
Donald Trump was sworn in as the 47th president of the United States at his inauguration ceremony
The inauguration is a triumph for President Trump, who returned to Washington to serve a second term four
Trump is known for being a political disruptor, and at 78, he is the oldest American
A triumph is a great victory or success, often won with a lot of skill or effort.
Triumph describes a feeling of great happiness after reaching a major achievement.
